slide_1.first_textbox: A distributed service team adopted AI-assisted workflows to classify incidents, identify recurring failure patterns, and route urgent tickets to the correct response owners before service levels degraded.
slide_1.second_textbox: Managers combined queue metrics, staffing signals, and incident categories to coordinate daily decisions and reduce reactive escalations.
slide_1.third_textbox: Routing quality improved across regional queues
slide_1.fifth_textbox: On-call effort shifted to complex cases
